method.nao_ao: CPC daily standardized observed indices; monthly values are arithmetic means of the observed daily index (>=90% coverage).
method.enso: CPC ERSSTv6 3-month overlapping seasons; ONI absolute SST anomaly, RONI relative anomaly; official ENSO monitoring uses RONI from 2026.
method.episodes: Warm/cold ±0.5 degC for at least five consecutive overlapping 3-month seasons; short threshold crossings are not confirmed episodes.
